summary: Honeypot telemetry shows attackers exploiting exposed AI infrastructure (LiteLLM MCP gateway auth bypass, MCP server test-endpoint command injection, blind prompt injection against agent frameworks) to gain unauthenticated RCE, then deploying Monero miners (gmon, XMRig) disguised with AI-tooling paths such as /app/data/.claude/ and /usr/src/node-red/. Post-exploitation focuses on AI-specific secrets, including querying the LiteLLM process's Python module state for the master key in memory and abusing the default master key sk-1234 for model enumeration.
